infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Parklane talks to smart devices and your home hub on your local network while you set them up and control them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Parklane reads the name of the Wi-Fi network you are on to check that you joined a device’s setup network. iOS shares network names only with apps allowed to use location.

plugins.microphonePermission: Parklane uses the microphone so you can talk to the Parklane Assistant.

plugins.cameraPermission: Parklane uses the camera so the assistant can see what you show it, so security staff can scan visitor parking passes, so you can scan the QR code on a smart device while setting it up, and so you can photograph medical documents for your Health Passport.
